question: What Is the Difference Between ATEX and IECEx?
body_html:
The difference between ATEX and IECEx is legal scope: ATEX is mandatory in the European Union, while IECEx is a voluntary global certification scheme. Both use the same IEC 60079 standards.

PointATEXIECEx
RegionEU and EFTA countriesWorldwide
ProofCE mark and Ex symbolIECEx Certificate of Conformity
Equipment groupsCategories 1, 2, 3 (G and D)EPL only (Ga, Gb, Gc, Da, Db, Dc)
AssessmentNotified Body for higher categoriesIECEx approved test labs

Many manufacturers certify under both.
